verdict.rationale: Choosing a data region or residency is a fair question for a SaaS customer data platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions regional workspaces, an EU data region, or any residency controls for where Segment itself stores or processes data. The Data Storage Destinations (warehouses, S3, GCS) only send copies of raw data to your own storage, and the GDPR and privacy-tool mentions do not describe region selection, so neither counts as residency choice.
